events.title: Corcept Therapeutics (CORT) Reports Q1 Loss, Misses Revenue Estimates
events.body: Corcept (CORT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -1.11% and -4.37%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Xencor (XNCR) Reports Q4 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
events.body: Xencor (XNCR) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +86.00% and +30.62%, respectively, for the quarter ended December 2025. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Xencor: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
events.body: PASADENA, Calif. AP) — Xencor Inc. XNCR) on Wednesday reported a loss of $6.7 million in its fourth quarter.
